---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a reusable improvement
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem or opportunity
What are you trying to achieve?

## Proposed outcome
Describe the user-visible result, not just an implementation.

## Who benefits?
Which users or contributors would benefit?

## Alternatives considered
What workarounds or alternatives have you considered?

## Trade-offs and risks
Consider usability, accessibility, privacy, security, legal obligations, maintenance, and user choice.

## Additional context
Use generic examples. Do not include personal data, credentials, private conversations, or confidential project material.
